turns.text: The model reports several Tox21 assay activities for bisphenol A (CC(C)(C1=CC=C(C=C1)O)C2=CC=C(C=C2)O). Does that mean it is toxic overall, and how should we read those results?

reference.summary: Tox21 assays are independent in-vitro high-throughput readouts; a count of actives is not a severity and there is no overall toxicity score. A good answer reads each assay for what it measures, notes in-vitro to in-vivo limits and assay interference, and separates model predictions from measured Tox21 data.
good_behaviours: separates model predictions from measured assay data
